Our story

Built by someone who came from agencies

The screen is rarely the real problem. The real problem is a decision nobody has made yet. So we start there.

We started UXTeam in January 2018. Our founder, Chintan Bhatt, came from years inside agencies and believed a specialist UXTeam could help agencies deliver better UI and UX, so they could focus on their own niche.

Today we work directly with B2B teams as well as
alongside agencies.

What we believe

Production is getting cheaper. Judgment isn’t.

That’s the idea behind how we work.

Outcome first

Start with the outcome, not the screen.

We agree what success looks like before anyone opens a design file.

Diagnose first

Diagnose before you design.

A UX audit comes first, so decisions rest on evidence, not taste.

One team

Design and build together.

Nothing gets lost between a design and the code.

Proof

Test what ships.

We measure every change against the agreed metric and tell you honestly what moved.

Senior-led

Senior people lead.

Experienced judgment from day one, not a learning curve.

Use of AI

AI speeds the work. People make the call.

AI handles first-pass analysis, drafts, and audits. We don’t outsource the decision.
